name: battle_phantom_redeal
description: Mid-refill-shortfall guard (battle_turn_draw atomicity + lossless reshuffle): a 6-card deck deals an opening 5-card hand (pile 1), then one 2-card combo leaves 2 slots open with only 1 card remaining and 2 in discard. The refill must reshuffle immediately (EVENT_DECK_RESHUFFLED x1, discard redealt to 0) instead of dealing 1 real + 1 phantom sword and suppressing the shuffle, and the reshuffle must preserve the 1 undrawn leftover (pile 3, redeal 2, draw_remaining 1) instead of deleting it. On the pre-fix ROM no reshuffle fires here and the phantom later bakes into the redealt pile.
